info.tactics: Paladins protect nearby allied characters from control effects. Interpose and Pure Will allow them to absorb debilitating conditions that would otherwise shut down their allies, while Lean on Me prevents forced movement. Paladins work well alongside allies who are typically vulnerable to tech actions, but they cannot mitigate damage.
info.terse: Frontline support that protects allies from control effects.

name: Pathos Shotgun
effect: This weapon gains +1 Accuracy if the Paladin or an allied character within Range 3 is suffering from a hostile condition.

actions.name: Interpose
actions.trigger: A hostile character inflicts any number of conditions on an allied character within Range 5 of you.
actions.detail: You may interrupt the triggering character, moving your Speed towards your ally by the most direct route possible. If you are adjacent to your ally before the triggering action or reaction resolves, you receive the conditions instead.

name: Lean on Me
effect: The Paladin and adjacent allied characters cannot be moved involuntarily by characters smaller than the Paladin. Characters cannot benefit from this trait while either they or the Paladin are Immobilized.

active_effects.name: Lean on Me
active_effects.detail: You and adjacent allied characters cannot be moved involuntarily by characters smaller than you. Characters cannot benefit from this trait while either you or they are Immobilized.

name: Pure Will
effect: When another character would inflict Jammed or Stunned on the Paladin, it may make a Hull save against them. On a success, the triggering character instead inflicts Impaired on the Paladin for the same duration they would have inflicted Jammed or Stunned.

active_effects.name: Pure Will
active_effects.condition: Another character would inflict Jammed or Stunned on you.
active_effects.detail: You may make a Hull save against the triggering character. On a success, they instead inflict Impaired on you for the same duration they would have inflicted Jammed or Stunned.

name: Indignation
effect: 1/round, the Paladin or an allied character within Range 3 may take a quick action or reaction that would normally prevented by their hostile conditions. This trait cannot be used if it would cause the Paladin to exceed its Heat Cap.

active_effects.name: Indignation
active_effects.condition: You are able to take 4 Heat without exceeding your Heat Cap.
active_effects.detail: You or an allied character within Range 3 may take a quick action or reaction that would normally be prevented by hostile conditions.

name: Fiery Rebuke
effect: After using Interpose, even if it can no longer take reactions, the Paladin may rebuke the triggering character. Until the end of the next round, they cannot use the action or reaction that triggered Interpose. Different Invade options are considered separate actions for this effect's purposes.

actions.name: Fiery Rebuke
actions.detail: You rebuke the triggering character. Until the end of the next round, they cannot use the action or reaction that triggered Interpose. Different Invade options are considered separate actions for this effect's purposes.

add_special.detail: You cannot use the action or reaction that triggered the Paladin's Interpose. Different Invade options are considered separate actions for this effect's purposes.

actions.name: Fortify
actions.trigger: An allied character within line of sight and Range 5 is pushed, pulled, knocked back, or knocked Prone.
actions.detail: The movement or status is prevented, and the triggering character gains Immunity to all the above effects until the start of their next turn.

add_special.detail: You are Immune to pushing, pulling, knockback, and Prone.

actions.name: Share Burdens
actions.detail: If you are not suffering any hostile conditions, transfer one hostile condition from an allied character within Sensors to yourself. You suffer the condition as if it had originally been inflicted on you, while the allied character instead becomes Impaired until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Rallying Cry
actions.detail: Until the end of your next turn, you exude a Burst 3 aura. You and allied characters within the aura count as Invisible against tech attacks and make checks and saves against tech actions with +2 Accuracy. Each time a tech attack or tech action fails against an affected character, the attacker takes {2/3/4} AP Energy damage and you take 2 Heat. You cannot take this action again until its effects end.

active_effects.name: Rallying Cry
active_effects.condition: A character makes a tech attack or tech action against you or an allied character within Burst 3.
active_effects.detail: The target counts as Invisible against tech attacks and makes any checks or saves with +2 Accuracy. If the tech attack or tech action fails, the triggering character takes {2/3/4} AP Energy damage and you take 2 Heat.

name: Lay on Hands [Veteran]
effect: When the Paladin Stabilizes, it may additionally clear one hostile condition from itself or an adjacent character.

active_effects.name: Lay on Hands
active_effects.detail: You may additionally clear one hostile condition from yourself or an adjacent allied character.
